title: cystopteris fragilis subsp. canariensis
intro: Cystopteris fragilis subsp. canariensis, commonly known as the Canary Island Lady Fern, is a subspecies of fern native to the Canary Islands. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional folk medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris fragilis subsp. canariensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
